about: Retrieval evaluation set for this repository (Stage 22). Each question names the graph node that answers it: `symbol` is the node id in the wiring graph, `file` and `span` are its locator. A hit is a ranked `graft ask` result in the same file whose span lies inside an answer span. scripts/retrieval-eval.mjs runs the set; an answer whose node has moved is reported, not scored silently. The set lives in a dot-folder because graft never indexes one: kept under docs/, the questions' own lines ranked first for 12 of the 20 (2026-10-26).
